name: Harness MCP
description: Run, debug and approve Harness CI/CD pipelines and manage services, environments and feature flags from AI agents via Harness's official MCP server, for DevOps teams.

skills.name: List and Get Resources
skills.description: Lists, gets and searches Harness resources such as pipelines, services, environments, connectors and feature flags.

skills.name: Create, Update and Delete
skills.description: Creates, updates and deletes Harness resources, including Git-backed pipelines, after the user confirms each change.

skills.name: Execute Actions
skills.description: Runs and retries pipelines, imports pipelines from Git, toggles feature flags and syncs GitOps applications.

skills.name: Diagnose Failures
skills.description: Diagnoses pipeline executions, connectors, delegates and GitOps apps, returning stage timing and failure details.

skills.name: Project Status
skills.description: Shows a real-time Harness project health dashboard with recent executions, failure rates and deep links.
